content.text: Meghalaya, an Indian state in the northeastern part of the country is bordered to the north and northeast by India's Assam, and to the south and southwest by Bangladesh. This trip wrap will offer a peripheral show of Meghalayan lakes, hilltops, valleys, woodlands, beautiful vegetation, and untrodden fauna are all tempting retreats.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Visit Umiam River, to discover the beauty of the enchanting landscape
Dawki Bridge, River Boating, Balancing Rock sightseeing
Take a deviation to Mawlynnong Village and the Living Root Bridge
Nohsngithiang Falls, Seven Sisters Falls, Sankardev Kalakshetra Science Museum, Don Bosco Museum are worth seeing
Witness the various types of flora and fauna of Kaziranga
Enjoy an amazing jungle safaris at Kaziranga National Park

main.title: 7 Days 6 Nights Delightful Assam Meghalaya Tour Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival at Guwahati
items: Pickup from Guwahati Airport or Railway Station to the hotel. You can relax there.
After apt rest, you can explore the famous Sankardev Kalakshetra Science Museum which showcases the ethnic diverseness of Assam and the whole north-east region.
Overnight stay in Guwahati hotel.

days.title: Day 2 : Outing to Shillong
items: Following the breakfast, checkout of the hotel and take a 3 hour drive straight to the mesmerizing city of Shillong which is famously known to be the Scotland of the Eastern region.
On the way, you will come across the beautiful Umiam Lake, partitioned by Sylvian valleys and the attractive green Khasi-Pines and clear blue sky.
Evenings can be utilized by wandering in the famous busy markets, Don Bosco Museum, Ward's Lake, Lady Hydari Park. All these places are worth experiencing.
Check in at your hotel at Shillong.

days.title: Day 3 : Cherrapunjee Day
items: Mornings can be enjoyable to explore the scenic beauty of Shillong and drive down about 65 km to Cherrapunji.
The wettest destination to be known on earth, offers some of the enigmatic waterfalls namely the Seven Sisters Falls, Nohkalikai Falls.
Spend the evening admiring the scenic beauty of Cherrapunji's valley.
Later check in at your hotel for a restful sleep

days.title: Day 4 : Trip to Mawlynnong
items: Following the breakfast, drive 28 kms to the beautiful and cleanest village of Asia- Mawlynnong.
You will be witnessing the oldest Living Root Bridge, the mysterious Balancing Rock.
Drive back to Shillong and check in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 5 : Travel to Kaziranga National Park
items: Drive for about 250 km to Kaziranga National Park.
Explore the amazing vegetation, birds and animal species at the Kaziranga National Park.
Spend the night in the lodgings facilitated by the forest.

days.title: Day 6 : Day at Kaziranga
items: You can experience the Elephant Safari and witness the scenic beauty.(Safari depends on availability)
Enjoy jeep safari and witness the rare one horned Rhino and many species of animal.
Spend an enjoyable evening and night at the forest place.
Later check in at your hotel at Kaziranga for a good night sleep.

days.title: Day 7 : Departure
items: Following the breakfast, driving back to the Guwahati Airport or Railway Station will mark an end to the tour.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
